title: Two briefs told agents to fetch work that an agent cannot reach
foundBy: session agent, while checking a handoff note against the committed briefs

evidence.verified: `make demo` on 2026-09-18, read from the member sessions. The developer ran `git merge refs/campaign/orchestrator` 7 seconds into its first dispatch. The qa member ran `git checkout refs/campaign/orchestrator` 6 seconds into its own. Neither session holds a tool call that looks for the work anywhere else.

details:
The qa brief said to fetch the developer's branch, and the developer brief said to read `DESIGN.md` from the orchestrator. An agent can do neither. `fetch` and `push` belong to the orchestrator, and an agent that runs one is refused by role. In an earlier run qa spent three dispatches hunting for a branch it could never reach.

Both briefs now name `refs/campaign/orchestrator`, which is where the orchestrator's `push` lands its work. The orchestrator brief tells it to push to each member before it dispatches that member.

notes.text: The cause upstream is filed in the campaign repository's ledger as SAC-029: the orchestrator's orientation names `fetch` and never `push`. The briefs here carry the instruction until that is fixed.
